title: Joint Aircraft Rescue and Fire Fighting
description: U.S. Marines with Aircraft Rescue Firefighting, Headquarters and Headquarters Support Squadron, Marine Corps Air Station Futenma, U.S. Air National Guardsmen with 134th Air National Guard, 134th Air Refueling Wing, and Firefighters with Marine Corps Installations Pacific, conduct aircraft rescue and fire fighting training on Camp Hansen, Okinawa, Japan, June 12, 2025. Fire departments from MCAS Futenma, 134th ARW, and MCIPAC joined together to build confidence, unit cohesion, and mission readiness. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Martha Linares)
keywords: joint training, mcipac, Marines, AIr Force, Okinawa, firefighter
